// v0.6.16 animation/VFX data accessors.
function unitAnimationMap(unitName){
 const unit=canonicalUnit(unitName);
 return unit?.animation_standard||null;
}
function unitVfxSequence(unitName,key){
 return unitAnimationMap(unitName)?.vfx?.[key]||null;
}

      freeze:ATTACK_SPRITES['Sub-Zero']?.freeze||[]

}

}

html{

}
body{

  overflow:hidden;

}

}

}


/* v0.5.19 CORE ROSTER SAFE MODE ---------------------------------------

#summonScreen .summonRatesPanel,
#summonScreen .summonHeroArea,
#summonScreen .rarityGuide,
#summonScreen .summonBottomBar,
#summonScreen #summonResults,
#summonScreen #pullHistory{display:none!important}
#coreSummonNotice{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;
  min-height:calc(100dvh - 92px);padding:28px 22px;text-align:center;gap:12px;
}
